findings.description: Urban Land Development surrendered title to this 118-year-old, seven-storey, 117,435-square-foot Union Square office building by deed-in-lieu of foreclosure in August 2026, after defaulting on roughly $73.6 million of debt. Control passed to an affiliate of Argentic Investment Management, the lender that financed the 2019 purchase with a $78.5 million loan. Urban Land Development had bought the building in November 2019 for about $94 million in a joint venture with Urban Land Capital and Meyer Corporation; Federal Realty Investment Trust had sold it to Madison Capital and PGIM Real Estate for $69.3 million in August 2017. More than half the office space was empty at the handover. Every party named here is a company.

extra.new_owner: an affiliate of Argentic Investment Management
